## Use B612 Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set B612 Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'B612 Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the B612 Mono coding font

A font designed for the aerospace industry, with high readability. B612 Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

B612 Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## B612 Mono FAQ

### Is B612 Mono free?

Yes. B612 Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does B612 Mono support ligatures?

No. B612 Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get B612 Mono?

B612 Mono is available from GitHub and Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
